extracted.name: Pecan Crackers
extracted.description: This pecan cracker recipe makes a tasty treat and is simple to prepare. Graham crackers and pecans get topped with sweetened butter and baked.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Line a baking sheet with graham crackers. Sprinkle evenly with pecans.
Combine sugar, butter, and margarine in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat and spoon mixture over pecans, coating well.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden, about 12 minutes. Cool completely before serving.
